text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган runs with everything
she's got
and emerges victorious.
Delighted after defeating
Нарита Брайан,
she can't contain her excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then realizes that Нарита Брайан is not
yet
satisfied, so...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She decides to give her yet another
exciting bout
at the Hanshin Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
